2340763514.name: No Effect
2340763514.description: Deprioritizes moves that would have no effect on the target due to typing, ability, or item as well as stat boosts already at the max/min value, etc.

530809101.name: KO Moves
530809101.description: When the Pokémon sees that a move will cause the target to faint, it will prioritize it. Moves like Explosion, Sucker Punch, and priority moves have a chance to have higher priority. Focus Punch is included too, presumably to punish the player for healing when low.

3284274582.name: Smart
3284274582.description: Takes both self and target move, ability, and item effects into consideration.
